name: design-review-panel
description: Dynamic design review panel with no fixed reviewer cap: a core trio (UX Strategist, Craft Reviewer, Motion/Polish) plus auto-drafted specialists (Token/Theme Architect, Performance & Rendering, i18n & Adaptivity, Content & Microcopy, Data-Viz). Exclusive scopes with ownership transfer, project-aware probing (Tailwind/Panda/design tokens), scoped runs (--only/--add/--panel), role hints (--context), WCAG/APCA contrast modes, and adversarial verification of consensus findings (--verify). All reviewers run in parallel and produce a unified, evidence-cited report.
